newsitem.title: EGYPT: Interbank Egypt average pound 3.3859/3.3900 to dlr. [CORRECTED 17:36 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Interbank Egypt average pound 3.3859/3.3900 to dlr. [CORRECTED 17:36 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the average pound to dollar figure in the headline from 3.3883/3.3900.)
Private-sector Cairo banks quoted the dollar at 3.3830 to 3.3880 (corrects figure from 3.3980) pounds bid and 3.3850 to 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market on Monday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3859 (corrects figure from 3.3883) pounds bid and 3.3900 pounds offered. The averages compared with Sunday's 3.3865 and 3.3911 pounds.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) at 3.390868 buy and 3.395446 sell. -- Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
